title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_1
doc_notes: This is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing various reports, teletypes, and newspaper clippings regarding flying disc sightings and recovered objects in July 1947. / This document is an FBI case file containing various reports, memoranda, and teletypes regarding 'flying discs' or 'flying saucers' from 1947, including both hoax reports and serious military/intelligence inquiries.

encounters.summary: A Catholic priest in Grafton, Wisconsin, reported a metal disc crashed into his yard, which he held for the FBI; it was later identified as a circular saw blade with wires and tubes attached.
encounters.quote: The object still was warm, weighed about four or five pounds and was about one eighth of an inch thick

encounters.summary: An Idaho housewife reported seeing a fleet of eight saucer-shaped objects land on a mountainside near St. Maries, Idaho.
encounters.entity_behavior: fluttered like leaves to the ground
encounters.quote: fluttered like leaves to the ground

encounters.summary: A resident of Omaha, Nebraska, reported a flaming, solid circular disc dropped in the street in front of his house, burning with extreme heat.
A resident of Shreveport, Louisiana, reported a circular disc whirring in the air with fire spouting from its sides before landing.
encounters.quote: DISC WHIRLING WHEN SEEN IN AIR AND FIRE SEEN SPOUTING FROM SIDES

encounters.summary: A resident of Twin Falls, Idaho, reported finding a circular disc with a plastic dome and radio tubes in a neighbor's yard.
encounters.quote: A disc 30½" in diameter, circular in shape, it is dished like a saucer

encounters.summary: A 'flying disc' reported to have landed in a garden, burst into flames, and was extinguished by the fire department.
A 'flying disc' reported to have landed on a roof, burning and then extinguished.
Small burned spots found on a lawn following reports of smoke and metallic fragments.
encounters.quote: small burned spots about one and one half inches in diameter

encounters.summary: Witness reported seeing a strange object in the sky that descended in a spiral motion and disappeared.
encounters.quote: descending slowly... suddenly it dropped in a spiral motion

encounters.summary: Witness reported seeing three flat round discs flying at high speed.
encounters.quote: three flat round discs, having a white color to them
